context_requirements: Active cell cycle progression with dependence on PLK1 for mitotic entry and cytokinesis
Intact p53 pathway for robust CDKN1A/GADD45 induction and apoptosis
MYC-driven transcriptional program for maximal sensitivity to PLK1 inhibition
BRD4 expression for dual PLK/BRD4 inhibitor activity
falsifiers: No decrease in mitotic/proliferation genes (e.g., CCNB1, CDK1, BIRC5, AURKA) at 6 or 24 h
No induction of p53 targets (CDKN1A, GADD45A) at 24 h
No evidence of apoptosis (CASP3, BAX, PMAIP1) at 24 h
Strong and selective upregulation of MYC or BRD4 target genes at 6 h
Similar transcriptional response across all nine lines regardless of proliferation status

evidence.supports: PLK inhibitor volasertib does not affect MYC or HEXIM1 expression alone but augments BET inhibitor effects, indicating PLK inhibition primarily perturbs cell cycle rather than directly repressing MYC transcription
PLK inhibitor BI2536 sensitizes tamoxifen-resistant breast cancer cells to apoptosis, supporting pro-apoptotic and anti-proliferative transcriptional consequences
PLK1 inhibition synergizes with BRD4 inhibition in MYC-amplified medulloblastoma, linking PLK1 to MYC stability and cell cycle control
PLK inhibitor BI2536 induces programmed cell death (eryptosis) in non-nucleated cells, consistent with a general cell death response
